derivation:
by simpa only [← Real.abs_sinh, Real.sinh_arsinh] using
  (Real.self_le_sinh_iff (x := |Real.arsinh x|)).2 (abs_nonneg _)
explanation: Instantiate the inequality y ≤ sinh y for nonnegative y with |arsinh x|, then rewrite using abs_sinh and sinh_arsinh. The candidate is independent of the target.
